headline: How Raphinha's latest transformation made him into Barcelona's star striker
description: Before Raphinha became Barcelona's captain and converted into their main striker, he was Premier League battling relegation at Leeds United. It was the making of him.

headline: Martinez's Man United outburst begs the question: Why do Premier League executives stay silent?
description: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez publicly targeted the club's hierarchy last week. But why do you never hear from senior executives from Premier League clubs?

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Manchester United keen on Palace duo
description: Manchester United are monitoring Crystal Palace duo Ismaïla Sarr and Jean-Philippe Mateta. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Alexis Mac Allister: 'Something wasn't right' under Arne Slot at Liverpool
description: Alexis Mac Allister has said that Andoni Iraola fixed the issues within the Liverpool group left behind by his predecessor Arne Slot.

headline: Football watchdog chair asserts 'absolute' power to force City sale
description: The Independent Football Regulator will have "absolute power" to force Manchester City's owners to sell if they are ultimately found to have run the club improperly, the watchdog's chair has said.
